documentation.rationale: The identity and terms half is present: VIN, a decode that matches, an itemised price with the $85 doc fee, and history badges (no accident reported, single owner). The maintenance half is absent: no receipts, no attached history report, no gearbox records, no photos of the at-risk areas.

condition.rationale: Exterior photos show glossy paint, even panels, an intact soft top, clean wheels and stock exhaust and ride height, with no stated faults. That is partial evidence only. The early-2016 gearbox, time-based fluids, tire age, cabin water and underside are all unexamined.

price_value.rationale: The $22,979 ask sits above the top of the $19,120-$22,306 fair-value range (mid $20,363). The peer 2016 Sport at 32k miles asks $20,875. Low mileage justifies some premium, but not above the range on an undocumented early-2016 base car.

mission_fit.rationale: It is a manual, reliable, light roadster in California, a resellable Miata within the $27,000 ceiling, though above the ideal $10,000-$19,000 band. Fit is tempered by the early-2016 6MT risk and the probable time-based catch-up.

logistics.rationale: The franchise dealer is 285 mi away in the LA area, where independent Mazda PPIs are readily available. The car is CA-registered with current tags, and fly-and-drive is straightforward. PPI permission is not yet confirmed.

emotional_spec_fit.rationale: Soul Red with a manual and low miles is desirable. But this is the base Sport with cloth, no LSD or Bilstein, and the less desirable early ND1 build.

ppi_focus: Gearbox: warm shifts into 2nd and 3rd under load, check for grinding or popping out of gear, check MT fluid condition, confirm build date.
Clutch: engagement height and slip test in 5th and 6th; check for hydraulic leaks.
Scan for stored codes and confirm open or closed recalls by VIN.
Tire DOT dates, battery health test and brake-fluid moisture test.
Lift footwell carpets, check soft-top drains, seat-rail bolt corrosion and musty smell.
Soft-top fabric at the rear fold corners and header seal; water test if possible.
Underside: skid plate and bracket (recall 19V496000), diff pinion and output seals, valve cover and front crank seal seepage.
Water pump weep hole and coolant level and condition.
Paint meter on aluminum hood, fenders and trunk for respray; check nose for chips or PPF.
Suspension bushings and end links on a test drive; alignment check.
what_would_change_verdict: Up: a door-jamb date or records showing a later build or a warranty-replaced gearbox, plus a clean PPI on the 6MT.
Up: dated service records, including brake fluid, and recent tires or battery with receipts.
Up: the dealer moving the price into the fair-value range (about $20,000-$21,500).
Down: warm-shift grinding or synchro issues, cabin water evidence, a branded title, or a refusal to allow a PPI.
evidence.mission_note: A manual, stock, California ND Miata fits the enthusiast-bridge brief and resells easily within 6-24 months. Its weak spots are the early-2016 gearbox window and an ask above fair value, both of which bear on the bridge goals of reliability and price discipline.
evidence.rationale: The listing establishes identity and terms: the VIN decodes to a 2016 MX-5 Sport soft top, the price is itemised at $22,979 plus an $85 doc fee, and Autotrader history badges report no accident and a single owner, though the report itself is not attached. The photos show an apparently stock Soul Red car with an intact top, clean panels and factory wheels and exhaust. Nothing is observed wrong. However, the car's 2016 build places its 6-speed in the early ND1 failure window, and no build date or transmission history is provided. At roughly 1,100 miles per year, time-based items (brake fluid, MT and diff fluid, battery, likely original tires) are probably due, and none are documented. Two recalls likely applicable to this VIN (19V496000 skid plate, 24V695000 airbag software) have no closure evidence. The ask sits above the $19,120-$22,306 fair-value range. Planned first-30-day catch-up is in the immediate service estimate; no known repair is established by the listing itself.
evidence.next_action: Email Toyota of Glendora asking for the full Carfax, a door-jamb build-date photo, tire DOT and battery date codes, a Mazda VIN recall and warranty printout, and written agreement to an independent PPI before any deposit.
